text: In Kyrgyzstan, the Kyrgyz people hold a deep cultural significance for horses, valuing them for various purposes such as food, sports, and as a means of cultural expression. This cultural attachment to horses serves the goal of expressing their cultural values and distinguishing themselves from other ethnic groups. Horses are not only significant in Kyrgyz culture but are also consumed as food, reflecting their multifaceted role in the community. Additionally, horses are revered as "man's wings" and are bred for different purposes, further emphasizing their importance within Kyrgyz society. This behavior is widely regarded as normative within the sampled population, reflecting the strong cultural connection between the Kyrgyz people and horses.

In the cultural context of Kyrgyzstan, including the Soviet Union and nomadic communities, people experience and navigate various cultural differences, such as assimilation, nomadic practices, and religious influences. The goal of this behavior is to highlight and understand the cultural uniqueness and differences within the geographical, cultural, and religious relations with various groups, including Russians, Europeans, and Kazakhs. Kyrgyzstan is distinguished by its distinct cultural practices and influences compared to other countries and contexts. This behavior is widely regarded as normative within the sampled population, indicating a high level of acceptance and prevalence.

In Kyrgyzstan, particularly within household and financial management, women, especially mothers and wives, traditionally take on the responsibility of managing household chores and finances. This role is perceived as the woman's territory and is aimed at maintaining tradition and caring for the family. In return, family members and husbands are expected to receive care and provide financial support. This division of responsibilities is considered a common practice among a significant portion of the sampled population in Kyrgyzstan, reflecting the cultural norms and values associated with spousal and parental roles.

The Kyrgyz tend to speak in a very round about manner. T hey don’t' usually just state their point directly ; t hey tend to hint at things and very often t hey will give someone the answer they think they want to hear rather than the truth. While people may be indirect when giving answers or asking for assistance, they tend to be quite direct in asking what people from other cultures may feel as personal questions. It is common to ask about one’s marital status, salary, age, etc. Most people have a good sense of humor that tends to be on the warm side. Sarcasm does not usually go over well.

A little less than an arm’s length of personal space during conversations is the norm in most situations. This space tends to be less between good friends and family. When it comes to personal privacy, it is common for people to enter a room with a closed door without knocking. This tends to be the case if you are staying with a family as a guest. People may also seem surprised when you lock the door to your room or ask for them to knock before entering. Touching is common during conversations; especially on the hands, arms, shoulders, back. There tends to be more touching between members of the same gender than members of opposite genders.

Direct eye contact tends to be the norm to the degree that it is not deemed challenging or a "stare down." Avoiding one's eyes is usually reserved for when you are expected to be ashamed of yourself. Religiously observant men may avoid eye contact with women and vice-versa.

In social situations, the view of time is generally quite relaxed. For big dinner parties being 2 hours late is common . For a lunch get together around an hour would be normal. In business situations, people tend to be more punctual and it is a good idea to show up on time.

Women tend to be viewed as equals in most parts of the country. Many hold jobs and some hold positions of power, although salaries will most likely be lower. The women who do work are still expected to take care of all the household chores including, preparing the food, serving the food, and cleaning up afterwards. In many areas, women who smoke tend to be looked down upon. This is the case for foreign women as well. In the capital , Bishkek, and a few other areas, it is fine for women to smoke .

Many people will point with their faces. For example, i f something is "over there" they'll point their nose and raise their eyebrows ( the higher the eyebrows the further away something is ) . Blinking is often used to show agree ment to something someone sa ys or to just say "yes" . C lick ing the tongue is away to say “no”. For example, if you were at a bazaar being asked to buy something over and over again, a verbal “no” may not do the trick, but a tongue click will show that you are serious and that you don’t want to buy anything. W histl ing to get someone's attention from a distance, like across the street , is common. Most people will expect you t ake your shoes off when entering a home. When you are offered something at a dinner table, for example as a guest at someone's house, it is polite to refuse what you are offered 3 times before saying yes (even if you don't really want it). While some may see this as pressuring you into eating more or drinking more , it is just their way of being polite. If invited to a home, note that t he most honored guest of the night will usually be s a t furthest from the door.

The middle finger is recognized and is viewed a rude gesture. A more common equivalent is done by m aking an “o” sign with one hand and slapping the top of it with the other hand (palm flat) once or twice . Pointing a closed fist to someone is usually viewed as a threat to fight. Avoid eating greeting, and giving and/or receiving things with your left hand as it is commonly viewed as "dirty hand" thought to be used in the bathroom . Toasting to each other while drinking is an important part of bonding, so if drinking shots with others, avoid sip ping. It's better to refuse from the start rather than to stop in the middle of the evening when you start feeling tipsy , as i t will most likely offend the rest of the toasters who haven't had you drink with them yet.

The legal drinking age is 16 but is not heavily enforced. Penalties for possession, use, or trafficking in illegal drugs in are severe, and convicted offenders can expect long jail sentences and heavy fines.
Tips are not usually given at restaurants.

For M en : Conservative suits or tie and jacket in the cities and when dealing with government officials. Business casual may be appropriate in certain areas. For W omen : Stylish, yet somewhat conservative business suits or dresses and blouses are appropriate. Being well-groomed and having clothes neatly pressed is important. Jeans, t-shirts, and other less casual clothing is inappropriate in business situations.

Using Mr., Mrs., or Miss followed by the last name is quite common . It’s best to wait to be invited to call someone by their first name. It is a good idea to spend a little time reading a counterparts business card before putting it away and be sure to include your title on the card. Use your right hand or both hands to give and receive business cards.
It’s good to b e on time for meeting even though you may be kept waiting.

I f you are invited to someone’s home, it is polite to bring a gift to the host or hostess. Appropriate gifts include nice bottle of wine, liquor, chocolates or sweets. G ifts do not usually have to be wrapped and they tend to be opened right away.

Students wear school uniform which are black and white. School is from 8:30 AM to 3PM, Monday to Saturday. The elementary, middle and high schools form one school, so students from 6 to 17 years are in the same school. The students finish school when they are 17 (11th grade). The grades are from 1 to 5 and the best grade is 5. If you have a grade greater than or equal to 3, you pass. If you have less than 3, you fail.

In the bigger city there is more dating is common and men usually ask women out. In rural areas there is hardly any dating and if a girl has a boyfriend it is very secretive so the only people who know about it are her close friends.
